channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Família Bolsonaro virou problema até para a direita
item.description: The Bolsonaro family has become a liability even for Brazil's right wing, as recent polling shows declining support for Flávio Bolsonaro following revelations about his ties to jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro and alleged requests for funds intended for a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. This has triggered panic among right-wing allies, who now see a return to power as increasingly difficult and distant.

item.title: Ministro do TSE cita Lula na Sapucaí de precedente para filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: A minister of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) cited the unanimous rejection of an injunction seeking to ban the Acadêmicos de Niterói parade, which honored President Lula, as a precedent for the case of the film 'Dark Horse,' about the political trajectory of Jair Bolsonaro. Despite the current different composition of the TSE, the court understands that the precedent applies to evaluating freedom of expression in political manifestations, including audiovisual works.

item.title: Infra em 1 Minuto: data centers exigem expansão da geração de energia
item.description: The expansion of data centers in Brazil requires increased electricity generation, with the self-production requirement sparking debate over investment attractiveness. The expert notes Brazil has a clean energy matrix but faces a supply bottleneck to meet projected demand of 13.2 GW by 2035.

item.title: Governo Lula dobra gastos e paga R$ 21 mi em anúncios no Instagram e Facebook para divulgar entregas
item.description: The Lula government spent R$ 21 million on Instagram and Facebook ads by mid-May, nearly double the amount spent in the same period of 2025, to promote federal investments in key states like São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro and Bahia, as well as the New Growth Acceleration Program (PAC) and income tax exemption for those earning up to R$ 5,000 monthly. The spending aims to bolster the government’s image in an election year, focusing on social programs and infrastructure projects before the July 4 ban on institutional advertising set by the Superior Electoral Court (TSE).

item.title: Relação Flávio-Vorcaro domina as redes sociais e alcança 2,73 bilhões de visualizações
item.description: The relationship between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and banker Daniel Vorcaro generated 2.73 billion views on social media after leaked audio was revealed by Intercept Brasil. Engagement peaked on May 14 with 632,000 posts in 24 hours, and negative sentiment toward the senator rose from 45% to 56.6%. The narrative shifted to attacks on Intercept Brasil and journalists, spreading claims of 'political persecution' and 'selective leak', especially on X and Telegram.

item.title: Congelamento de despesas ajuda a pagar redução da fila do INSS, mas governo mantém déficit
item.description: The Lula government raised spending freezes to R$ 23.7 billion, driven by revised estimates for BPC and Social Security spending, enabling faster reduction of the INSS backlog, which currently stands at 2.3 million pending applications. Despite the freeze, the primary deficit remains largely unchanged at R$ 60.3 billion, reflecting ongoing fiscal challenges. The freeze targets discretionary spending, with 20% allocated to parliamentary amendments, and includes a phased disbursement to prevent premature spending by ministries.

item.title: PT e PL pregam cautela após Lula abrir vantagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro em pesquisa Datafolha
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) by nine points in the first round and four points in the second round, following the 'Dark horse' scandal revelations. Bolsonaro’s support dropped to 31% in the first round (from 35%) and 43% in the second (from 45%), while Lula rose to 40% and 47%. Despite the decline, the second-round scenario remains a technical tie due to a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Pressão por CPI do Master vira guerra de narrativas no Congresso; sete iniciativas aguardam análise
item.description: Seven initiatives to establish CPIs in Congress to investigate Banco Master are facing resistance from legislative leadership, particularly Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who again blocked the commission’s opening. Although a Chamber request with over 200 signatures (Rodrigo Rollemberg, PSB-DF) has been filed, it awaits processing behind 15 prior CPI proposals. The debate resurfaced due to revelations linking Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) to former banker Daniel Vorcaro, turning the issue into a narrative battleground between government and opposition ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Janet Murguía: “La amenaza no solo es para los inmigrantes, sino para todos los estadounidenses”
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court weakened Voting Rights Act protections for Black and Latino minorities in Louisiana, legitimizing an aggressive Republican-favoring redistricting that dilutes Black electoral power across the South. Shortly after, Virginia’s state Supreme Court overturned a Democratic-backed redistricting plan approved by referendum, undermining a multiracial coalition strategy that had seemed poised to help Democrats regain the House in November’s midterms. As Janet Murguía warns, the threat extends beyond immigrants to all Americans.

item.title: Para o bolsonarismo, o importante é continuar a existir
item.description: The revelation of messages and audio involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro damaged his image in the Datafolha poll, expanding Lula’s lead over him from 3 to 9 percentage points in the first-round simulation for the 2026 elections. Despite losing competitiveness, Flávio Bolsonaro remains the bolsonarist candidate, with no apparent fact capable of removing him from the race two months before the formalization of tickets.

item.title: Datafolha: 48% defendem que Flávio Bolsonaro deveria abrir mão da candidatura após divulgação de suas conversas com Vorcaro
item.description: A Datafolha poll reveals that 48% of voters believe Flávio Bolsonaro should withdraw his presidential candidacy following the disclosure of his conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro, while 44% say he should remain in the race. Among Bolsonaro’s own voters, 88% support him staying in the race. The survey also found that 72% of respondents perceive a close relationship between Bolsonaro and Vorcaro.

item.title: Crise do Master reaviva racha entre grupos de Flávio Bolsonaro e Michelle
item.description: The crisis involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and his relationship with former banker Daniel Vorcaro of Master has reignited the rift between his political circle and the circle of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, both from the PL party. The revelations about ties to Vorcaro, linked to controversial financial operations, have sparked internal party tensions, undermining the cohesion of the Bolsonarist base ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: DC faz vídeo de IA mostrando Joaquim Barbosa como pré-candidato à presidência: ‘virar a página’
item.description: The Christian Democracy party (DC) released an AI-generated video featuring former STF justice Joaquim Barbosa as a presidential pre-candidate, with the message 'turn the page'. The video sparked an internal crisis, as Aldo Rebelo — previously announced as the party’s pre-candidate — was expelled by party president João Caldas, who accused Rebelo of crossing all lines and having ties to the Banco Master case.

item.title: Mesmo atrás, Flávio “resistiu ao ataque”, diz oposição
item.description: Chamber opposition leader Cabo Gilberto Silva (PL-PB) stated that, despite Flávio Bolsonaro trailing Lula in the Datafolha poll (47% to 43%), the senator 'resisted the attack' he faced in recent weeks. The poll indicates a potential 2026 runoff advantage for President Lula. The remark aims to emphasize Bolsonaro's resilience amid media and political pressure.

item.title: Kassab avalia crescimento de Caiado após Datafolha
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, interpreted the Datafolha poll results as a sign of openness for the growth of pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado. He emphasized that the most relevant point for the PSD's prospects is not the voting intentions themselves, but the upward trend observed in the survey.

item.title: Leia a íntegra do discurso de Kalil na Academia Nacional de Medicina
item.description: Cardiologist Roberto Kalil Filho was sworn in as a titular member of the National Academy of Medicine in the presence of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, marking the first time a Brazilian president attended the institution’s ceremony. In his speech, Kalil defended the Unified Health System (SUS), criticized misinformation and the sensationalism of medicine, emphasizing that technological advances do not replace the human dimension of the profession, including compassion, empathetic listening, and moral responsibility.

item.title: Democracia Cristã publica vídeo que anuncia Joaquim Barbosa como pré-candidato à Presidência
item.description: The Christian Democracy party (DC) released an AI-generated video announcing former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa as its pre-candidate for the 2026 presidential election. The video shows Barbosa turning off televisions displaying images of rivals such as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, declaring: 'It's time to turn the page'. This decision replaced former minister Aldo Rebelo, who was expelled from the party after criticizing the move and calling it an 'affront' and a 'trial balloon'.

item.title: Após Caiado marcar 4% em pesquisa, Kassab diz que 'não há nada consolidado'
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, said the Datafolha poll shows nothing is yet consolidated in the 2026 elections, despite Ronaldo Caiado rising to 4% in voting intentions. He highlighted high rejection rates for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro as a positive sign for Caiado’s growth, whose rejection increased to 15%. Kassab also commented on the 'Dark Horse' case, expressing trust in institutions and the need for candidates to provide explanations.

item.title: Lula defende fim da escala 6×1 sem período de transição
item.description: President Lula (PT) advocates for an immediate reduction of the workweek from 44 to 40 hours without a transition period, including two paid rest days and no salary cuts. He plans to meet with House Speaker Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) and Labor Minister Luiz Marinho next week to discuss the bill. Lula emphasized the benefits for health, education, and family life, particularly for women.

item.title: Com presença de Lula, Kalil toma posse na Academia Nacional de Medicina
item.description: Cardiologist Roberto Kalil Filho was sworn in as a member of the National Academy of Medicine in the presence of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, marking the first time a Brazilian president attended such an induction. Kalil defended the Unified Health System (SUS), warned against medical misinformation and spectacle, and emphasized that science without ethics is dangerous and technology cannot replace human compassion in medicine.

item.title: STF autoriza volta de Vorcaro a cela ocupada por Bolsonaro dentro da PF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized former banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to return to a State-Major room in the Federal Police Superintendency, a space previously used by former President Jair Bolsonaro during his investigation. The decision sparked controversy by linking Vorcaro, investigated in Operation Car Wash, to a symbolic location associated with Bolsonaro.

item.title: Marqueteiro do PL, Duda Lima afirma que Flávio deve se recuperar e voltar a subir nas pesquisas
item.description: Political marketer Duda Lima, affiliated with the PL, says Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is expected to recover and rise again in the polls following a decline linked to the release of an audio in which he asks for money from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master.

item.title: Vídeo de IA: DC divulga ex-STF Joaquim Barbosa como presidenciável. Vídeo
item.description: An AI-generated video released by the Christian Democracy Party (DC) presents former STF Justice Joaquim Barbosa as a 2026 presidential pre-candidate, criticizing the polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The video ties Bolsonaro to investigations involving Banco Master and highlights Lula’s remarks on crime and drug users, ending with Barbosa in judicial robes symbolizing a break from the status quo. The move intensifies an internal party rift, leading to the expulsion of Aldo Rebelo, who had previously been named the party’s pre-candidate.

item.title: Confederação Nacional da Indústria vai ao STF contra o fim da taxa das blusinhas
item.description: The National Confederation of Industry (CNI) filed a direct action of unconstitutionality (ADI) at the Supreme Federal Court (STF) against Provisional Measure 1.357/2026, which revoked the 'blusinhas tax' of 20% on international purchases up to US$50. The CNI argues the MP lacks constitutional urgency, constituting an electoral urgency not recognized by the Constitution, and violates principles such as tax equality, free competition, and protection of the domestic market, while also causing fiscal revenue loss and job losses.

item.title: Caiado diz que governo de Lula é “Brasil colônia”
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Lula's government, claiming Brazil remains in a 'colonial Brazil' era due to the lack of policies promoting scientific-technological development and natural resource utilization. He stated the country has lost ground in renewable energy, artificial intelligence, and globalization, and that 20 years of PT rule have left productive sectors bankrupt. Caiado also reiterated his support for amnesty for those accused of the January 8 attacks and described himself as a 'man of science'.

item.title: Quem são os pré-candidatos a senador pela Bahia (BA) nas eleições 2026
item.description: In the 2026 Brazilian Senate elections for Bahia, six politicians have positioned themselves as pre-candidates: former governors Jaques Wagner (PT) and Rui Costa (PT), Angelo Coronel (Republicans, formerly PSD), Delliana Ricelli (PSOL), João Roma (PL), and Marcelo Santtana (DC). The race is expected to feature two former PT governors and only one woman among the pre-candidates, while the current Senate delegation includes Otto Alencar (PSD) serving until 2031 and Angelo Coronel and Jaques Wagner, whose terms end in January 2027 and who are running for re-election.

item.title: Zema diz que está mais para fazer o certo que para ganhar eleição
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pre-candidate for the Novo party, stated he prefers 'doing the right thing' over 'winning elections', rejecting the possibility of being Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate. He sharply criticized Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged ties to the founder of Banco Master, involved in financing the film 'Dark Horse', calling the explanations 'unconvincing' and damaging to presidential credibility. Zema described his party as small but 'the most combative in Brasília' and affirmed his campaign will continue to the end.

item.title: Dólar sobe para R$ 5,028; Bolsa perde os 176 mil pontos
item.description: The dollar rose to R$ 5.028 and the Ibovespa fell to 176,209 points as investors priced in a Datafolha poll showing Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential runoff, within a 2-point margin of error. Markets also reacted to Kevin Warsh’s appointment as Fed chair, signaling prolonged high U.S. interest rates, and to Brent oil closing at $103.54.

item.title: CNI recorre ao STF contra fim da ‘taxa das blusinhas’
item.description: The National Confederation of Industry (CNI) filed a direct action of unconstitutionality at the Federal Supreme Court (STF) to suspend the federal government's tax exemption on low-value international purchases, known as the 'tax on little shirts'. The move aims to block the repeal of the 20% tax rate on imports under US$50, enacted by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Samara Martins, pré-candidata à Presidência pelo UP, aparece empatada com Zema em pesquisa
item.description: Samara Martins, from the Unidade Popular pelo Socialismo (UP), is tied with Zema in a Datafolha poll, each with 3% of voting intentions, making her the only female pre-candidate for president so far. The result reflects her low national visibility but highlights her role as a radical left-wing representative in the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: Caiado defende convocação de Neymar e diz que Ancelotti é “craque”
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) praised the official call-up of the Brazilian national team for the World Cup, commending coach Carlo Ancelotti’s selection criteria and calling him a 'crack'. He also advocated for Neymar’s return to the squad, stating the player deserves a spot. The remarks were made in an interview published by O Antagonista.

item.title: 'Luta contra um sistema dificílimo': Zambelli comemora soltura na Itália; assista ao vídeo
item.description: Former federal deputy Carla Zambelli was released in Italy after the Court of Cassation annulled the decision authorizing her extradition to Brazil. She celebrated her liberation in a video alongside her lawyers, thanking them for their support in fighting a difficult judicial system. The ruling also impacts a second extradition request tied to other STF convictions, and her defense is still assessing whether she can travel freely despite being on Interpol’s red notice list.

item.title: “População não absorveu escândalos que atingiram membros do STF”, afirma Ronaldo Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, pre-candidate for President from the PSD, stated that the Brazilian population has not absorbed the scandals involving members of the Supreme Federal Court, which has compromised the judiciary's image in public opinion. He emphasized that these episodes have affected the balance of powers in Brazil.

item.title: Centrão vê caminho aberto para novo nome na corrida presidencial
item.description: Centrão leaders see an opening for a new name to enter the presidential race, as pre-candidates like Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema have failed to gain traction despite the scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro. Voters dissatisfied with Bolsonaro’s son but previously inclined toward the PL may shift to a third-way option. Thus, an unknown candidate could emerge as a viable contender for a runoff spot.

item.title: A dentista do SUS que empatou com Zema e Renan no Datafolha
item.description: Samara Martins, a SUS dentist and pre-candidate for the Popular Unity Party (UP), obtained 3% voting intention in the Datafolha poll released on March 22, tying with candidates Romeu Zema and Renan Calheiros. She is the sole UP representative in the 2026 presidential race and works in the interior of Rio Grande do Norte. Her result highlights the presence of left-wing candidacies focused on social and public health agendas.

item.title: Caiado explica como pretende anistiar Bolsonaro
item.description: PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that, if elected, he would sign a decree of amnesty benefiting those involved in the January 8 events and former president Jair Bolsonaro. The measure aims to pardon criminal liability for participants in the January 8 attacks, including Bolsonaro, who is under investigation for his role. The statement was made in an interview with O Antagonista.

item.title: "Vamos ver quem é quem", diz Lula sobre redução da jornada de trabalho
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated for an immediate reduction of the workweek from 44 to 40 hours without salary cuts, and the end of the 6x1 work scale, proposing a 5x2 schedule as standard. He criticized transitional proposals, stating that opponents must publicly take a stance, and announced a meeting with the Chamber president and the labor minister to advance the PEC vote.

item.title: Carla Zambelli deixa prisão na Itália e comemora em vídeo
item.description: Former Brazilian deputy Carla Zambelli (PL-SP) was released from prison in Italy after Italy’s Court of Cassation annulled the decision authorizing her extradition to Brazil. She celebrated in a video, calling the decision a 'victory of God' and stating she intends to pursue a 'life of mission'. Zambelli had been detained since July 2025 over STF convictions related to the hacking of the National Justice Council’s system and illegal firearm possession in 2022.

item.title: Caiado afirma que explicações de Flávio sobre Banco Master não convenceram a população
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado of the PSD stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's explanations regarding Banco Master failed to convince the public. Caiado argued that the senator's arguments were insufficient to address public concerns about the matter.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: Lula diz que vai se reunir com Motta e afirma ser contra transição: 'É brincar de fazer redução'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said he will meet with Chamber President Hugo Motta to discuss ending the 6x1 work schedule. He opposes a transition period for reducing the workweek, advocating for an immediate shift from 44 to 40 hours weekly without salary reduction. Lula dismissed gradual reductions as 'playing at making reductions'.

item.title: Lula diz que defenderá fim das bets na campanha de 2026
item.description: President Lula stated he will advocate for the end of online betting platforms (bets) in the 2026 election campaign, calling them a social problem linked to family indebtedness and addiction, especially among youth and low-income groups. He emphasized he cannot unilaterally ban bets due to congressional dependence, but announced a new secretariat in the Ministry of Finance for regulation and the blocking of thousands of illegal sites. Lula compared the debate to past tobacco advertising restrictions and highlighted the sector’s political and economic influence.

item.title: NOVO DATAFOLHA dá EMPATE TÉCNICO entre LULA e FLÁVIO no 2º TURNO
item.description: A Datafolha poll released shows a technical tie between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and candidate Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 second round. Both candidates are polling within the margin of error, indicating a highly competitive race. The result reflects deep polarization in the Brazilian electorate, setting the stage for a closely contested runoff.

item.title: Lula diz que monitora preço dos combustíveis todos os dias
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that he monitors fuel prices daily and advocates for strict public oversight against abusive increases, involving the Federal Police and ANP. He announced a gasoline subsidy of R$ 0.44 per liter, costing about R$ 1.2 billion monthly for at least two months, and noted that only one-third of Brazil’s rare earth mineral potential has been mapped.

item.title: Lula sugere fundo nacional para exploração de terras-raras
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva proposed the creation of a national fund to manage revenues from rare earth mineral exploration, aiming to add value to the production chain and avoid repeating the historical model of exporting raw materials. He emphasized that Brazil, holding the world’s second-largest rare earth reserves, is attracting growing interest from the United States and Europe amid global geopolitical competition for minerals critical to energy transition technologies. The government is already discussing national control measures, including a presidency-linked council and the CIMCE, to safeguard sovereignty over these strategic resources.

item.title: Malafaia, sobre evangélicos petistas: Flávio errou, mas PT não tem moral para acusar ninguém -
item.description: Evangelical pastor Silas Malafaia criticized the inconsistency of evangelical PT supporters, acknowledging that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro made mistakes but arguing that the PT lacks moral authority to accuse anyone due to its own history. He argued that the party’s lack of credibility undermines the legitimacy of its criticisms, even when valid. The statement reflects the religious-left polarization in the context of the 2026 Brazilian elections.

item.title: CNI vai ao STF para retomar a ‘taxa das blusinhas’
item.description: The National Confederation of Industry (CNI) filed a lawsuit at the STF against President Lula's provisional measure that revoked the 20% tax on international purchases up to $50, known as the 'blusinhas tax'. The CNI argues the revocation harms the domestic market, violates equality and free competition, and will lead to job losses and economic damage. The tax, in effect since August 2024, generated approximately R$5 billion in 2025.

item.title: O Flávio caiu no Datafolha. E subiu 13 pontos esse ano
item.description: Despite predictions of collapse following the audio leak with Vorcaro, Flávio maintained his support level in polls, with only a 4-point drop in Datafolha within the margin of error. His current support (31%) is 13 points higher than in December 2023 when he was launched as a candidate, showing real growth. The 'market' narrative treating voters as rational agents based on economic indicators fails to capture the lived reality of voters like Seu Jorge, whose priorities lie in events like the World Cup, not bank balances.

item.title: Governo diz que 100 mil escolas públicas já têm internet adequada
item.description: The Brazilian government announced that 100,720 public schools now have adequate internet for pedagogical use, covering 72.9% of the 138,086 public schools nationwide. The Connected Schools Program, led by the Ministries of Education and Communications, is progressing toward the goal of full connectivity by the end of 2026, with notable growth in the North Region.

item.title: “Daqui a pouco, Flávio vai voltar a crescer”, diz marqueteiro do PL
item.description: PL strategist Duda Lima says Flávio Bolsonaro will regain polling ground after negative impact from audio requesting funds from Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro, asserting his base won't switch to Lula and the race will be very close. He also cited Andrei Roman of AtlasIntel noting bolsonarism has lost its mobilizing power, while the left cannot benefit due to its own structural crisis. Recent polls show Lula at 47-48.9% and Flávio at 41.8-43%, indicating a technical tie.

item.title: Candidatura de Flávio balançou, mas não caiu
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy declined in polls following the Dark Horse scandal, though allies describe the drop as temporary and reversible. A Datafolha survey shows Lula leading with 47% against Flávio's 43% in a potential runoff scenario.
